guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use one canonical documentationAlignment validator for active, finish, archive, and PR Summary checks.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: scripts/ai_check_summary.py owns both the skeleton and validator; ai-finish and PR/archive checks consume the same Summary validation path.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Alignment evidence reports repository facts; it must not become a second capability or verification truth source.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Field and lifecycle docs state that alignment maps evidence and does not replace tests, hosted evidence, provider controls, or Capability Truth.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Require bidirectional declaration between alignment evidence and changedFiles or sourcesUsed.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The validator requires evidence paths in changedFiles or sourcesUsed and reverse-covers changed documentation/command surfaces.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve immutable historical archives through explicit compatibility rather than backfill.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: legacy_archive mode accepts an absent field without modifying historical files; focused and expanded archive regressions pass.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep starter, installer, example, documentation, and tests structurally synchronized.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: ai-start, installer adoption/upgrade, and the checked example use or assert the same canonical five-domain skeleton.

risk.detail: The new gate is repository-local and path-based. Semantic correctness still requires human review; tests prove structural completeness and source binding, not that prose is universally correct.

observedIssues.fact: The comprehensive plan requires a structured documentationAlignment record, while the canonical Summary validator currently rejects that field as unknown.
observedIssues.decision: Complete this dedicated corrective before resuming performance or release work.
observedIssues.resolution: Implemented the required five-domain schema, source-bound reverse evidence checks, generator parity, archive compatibility, documentation, and regressions.
observedIssues.followUp: Complete this Work Item's full PR/CI/merge/close lifecycle before resuming the paused performance Work Item.

observedIssues.fact: After RFE-117 archive, no-active current_status correctly claimed a clean stable marker while the uncommitted archive bundle made check-ai-status-consistency fail; repair-ai-status regenerated the same marker and could not resolve the transient state.
observedIssues.decision: Do not mutate archived evidence or bypass PR ownership; commit the complete archive bundle, then validate the committed no-active state.
observedIssues.resolution: The committed-state consistency check passed and PR #414 completed; retain this recurrence for the user's consolidated process review rather than expanding RFE-118.
observedIssues.followUp: At plan completion, decide whether the status checker needs an explicit archived-but-uncommitted transition state.

observedIssues.fact: The comprehensive plan and PLAN-DIRECTIVE-003 reference make check-doc-links, but neither the repository Makefile nor adopter Makefile template defines that target.
observedIssues.decision: Use the existing system-invariant gate as the authority: migrate current traceability references to real document gates and do not add a no-op compatibility alias.
observedIssues.followUp: Full quality must prove the system-invariant and instruction-traceability gates pass with no missing target reference.

observedIssues.fact: Installer-finalized documentationAlignment evidence cited the active Contract; ai-finish moved that Contract into the archive but only rewrote changedFiles, leaving the new evidence path dangling at PR validation.
observedIssues.decision: Repair the general archive transition and add lifecycle regression coverage instead of special-casing adoption or weakening path existence checks.
observedIssues.resolution: The archive path-rewrite phase now rewrites exact references inside documentationAlignment while intentionally preserving executionContractPath and command evidence from the execution moment.
observedIssues.followUp: Full quality and hosted adopter smoke must prove archived alignment evidence remains valid.

observedIssues.fact: While the real project-test process had run for more than five minutes, an internal fixture overwrote target/quality/timing/project-test.json with a passed 16ms record from the same shared path.
observedIssues.decision: Do not use the transient timing record as performance evidence; let the parent runner finish and retain the recurrence for the paused deep-performance Work Item.
observedIssues.resolution: The parent runner rewrote the final record to 445719ms and full quality passed; session isolation remains intentionally outside this corrective.
observedIssues.followUp: The deep-performance Work Item must isolate timing by run ID/commit and prove fixtures cannot overwrite live run evidence.

observedIssues.fact: The first full-quality attempt stopped in project-format-check because the new archive helper and journey fixture had not yet been Ruff-formatted.
observedIssues.decision: Apply the repository formatter and restart the complete quality pipeline rather than treating focused tests as sufficient.
observedIssues.resolution: Both files were formatted; the restarted full quality passed 1253 tests at 85.03% coverage and all remaining gates.
observedIssues.followUp: Retain formatter-first as a pre-heavy gate; no separate process change is required unless the final plan review decides to auto-format.

residualRisks.detail: A structurally aligned evidence map cannot independently prove that every sentence has the intended meaning; reviewer judgment and domain-specific checks remain necessary.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
